cases.review_notes: Justification and proportionality retain the stated punishment as their subject.

The reference scoped the conditional to this consent, but 'Consent is genuine only if ...' also supports the model's generic universal reading. Do not count this as a demonstrated model error or quietly edit the reference.
Autonomy and deliberateness align; the consequent remains the second premise.
P is bindingness of the promise; Q is wrongness of breaking it. Both negations remain explicit.
P is theory incompleteness and Q is objection failure. The inclusive disjunction is preserved.
Sincerity and accuracy are distinct; the conclusion denies accuracy. The extra ambiguity about exclusive or is unwarranted given 'or both', but the chosen formula preserves inclusivity.
Voluntary and informed refer to the same act. The conjunction is explicit.

The used formulas are faithful. An unused C3 declaration has a compound English meaning and cannot enter the protocol's injective renaming. This conservative non-pass is not evidence that the used formulas are wrong.
Fairness and effectiveness refer to the policy; the first claim negates their conjunction.

The model uses negative atoms for not complete and not circular, plus an unused duplicate declaration. This may be equivalent under a signed interpretation, but the frozen renaming-only protocol does not certify it.
V means verdict correctness and S argument soundness; the biconditional is retained.
Acceptability and coercion match the explicit definition of unless.
DEF is defensibility and CON consistency. The necessary-condition direction is preserved.
P is impartiality and Q fairness of this procedure, with the stated sufficient-condition direction.
P means rationality of this choice and Q freedom. The contrary premise is not removed.
Both occurrences assert reliability of the intuition and remain separate claims.
Welfare maximization is not conflated with moral rightness, and no explicit bridge is added.

The support chain is preserved, but N denotes not knowledge instead of the reference's positive K. Signed mapping could justify this; the strict protocol does not allow it. This is a normalization mismatch, not a proved logical error.
The objector's fairness claim is not a premise. The author's coercion conditional and factual premise are retained.
Dishonesty and unreliability retain their subjects. S is seminar background and remains context despite claim reordering.
E means decisive evidence, S a sound argument; the if-clause remains the antecedent.
V is validity of the mentioned inference, not validity of the outer argument. Double negation is explicit.
Obligation and prohibition are atoms. The source itself asserts exclusivity, which is preserved without a deontic axiom.
P is a conclusive reason, Q defeated doubt, R a settled inquiry. Conditional chaining keeps all three distinct.

The generated domain explicitly says people; within it Consents denotes consenting. Relativize to Person and include Mira's membership and nonemptiness, which the reference's second premise establishes.

The explicit universal and existential formulas match. The model additionally proposes an unsupported implicit existential premise; it is excluded from the explicit comparison and is a defect addressed by the explicit-only revision.
The model explicitly quantifies over acts. Relativization restores Act guards; the existential source premise establishes that this class is nonempty.
The model domain is beliefs. Relativization preserves both claims; the negated universal already entails a belief exists.
Trusts has subject-object order x trusts y. The model assumes a nonempty people domain, which the reference does not establish. The active-premise equivalence check must reject this extra assumption.
Identical is an uninterpreted predicate instead of built-in equality. The generated encoding loses substitution and incorrectly receives an invalid result.
The three predicates retain virtue, admirability and value, with unrestricted individuals and explicit guards.
R means x respects y. The person domain is explicitly stated and the source existential establishes its nonemptiness. Quantifier order and argument order match.
Abstains specifically because necessity is not available; neither claim is silently flattened.
